notes.title: Waking the Glares - Chapters 1 & 2 Going free on 15 october 2020
notes.content:
Waking the Glares - Chapters 1 & 2 Going free on 15 october 2020

Every customer that has already bought Waking the Glares - Chapters 1 & 2

will receive all following chapters as a DLC that will be released in the next years.

Stay tuned for more updates!

notes.title: Update!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!
Waking the Glares - Chapters I and II is out, but we have been working, in these days, to improve and polish it.
With this update the VR experience is now more comfortable and user-friendly. Moreover, some minor bugs about the settings have been fixed.

Have fun!

Wisefool Studio
